name: Capacity Fold
prompt: Compose S4Quota Main and Compact as one calm monochromatic desktop instrument. Make the five-hour remaining percentage dominant, the reset countdown secondary, the weekly quota an attached ruled horizon, and freshness/provider state explicit without dashboard cards. Use Tidal Almanac cadence and temporal markers, Optical Index baseline discipline, Source Sans 3 tabular figures, warm neutral Light/Dark roles, and a restrained capacity rail. Compact must prioritize percentage and countdown and stay silent in the normal state.
refinements: explicit limiting-window relationship without a vertical spine
cadence rail retained only as subordinate real data
